jd_text: We are seeking a Data Engineer to develop scalable data infrastructure and support data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will work with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain reliable data pipelines.

cv_evidence.text: Data Science and Business Analytics undergraduate with experience in data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML application development. Skilled in Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud data platforms. Experienced in developing data pipelines, building analytical solutions, and deploying AI-powered applications.

Programming: Python, SQL, R, JavaScript, TypeScript. Data Engineering: PySpark, Power Query, Informatica, ETL, ELT, Delta Lake. Cloud Platforms: Azure Databricks, AWS Redshift, Google Cloud Platform. Databases: PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, BigQuery, SQLite. Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, MLflow. Data Visualization: Tableau, Power BI.

Built Python ETL pipelines integrating East Asia sales, order, CPQ, WBS, and opportunity data, reducing manual processing time by approximately 80%. Developed reusable SQL queries in Amazon Redshift for recurring operational reporting across business functions. Created Tableau dashboards supporting Finance, Offer Marketing, and Customer stakeholders. Implemented logging and error-handling mechanisms to improve data pipeline traceability and maintainability.

Engineered PySpark ELT pipelines in Azure Databricks, transforming raw multi-client policy and claims data into production-ready Delta Lake tables within Unity Catalog. Developed modular data transformations for schema harmonization, lookup enrichment, and data validation. Built an LLM evaluation framework combining deterministic matching and LLM-as-Judge scoring. Migrated a local application to Databricks Apps and integrated React frontend components with FastAPI backend services.
Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Data Science and Business Analytics, University of London.
Google Advanced Data Analytics Professional Certificate. IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate. Databricks Generative AI Fundamentals.

Led a data analytics project involving the collection and processing of over 1,000 healthcare job listings using Python, BeautifulSoup, and Selenium. Analyzed salary ranges, qualification requirements, and job market trends using pandas and visualization libraries.

Migrated Tableau dashboards to Power BI to support retail analytics operations. Developed daily sales tracking dashboards with year-over-year comparisons. Implemented reporting improvements and conducted user training to support dashboard adoption.
Developed machine learning classification models and geospatial optimization techniques to analyze traffic collision risk and prioritize ambulance station locations.

jd_text: Develop and maintain scalable ETL and ELT data pipelines using Python and SQL. Design and optimize data transformation workflows using distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark. Build and maintain cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes. Implement automated CI/CD workflows for data engineering applications. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver reliable analytical solutions.
